societies.name: 93% Club Southampton
societies.description: The 93% Club Southampton is the University of Southampton branch of The 93% Club, the UK's largest network and least exclusive members' club for state-educated individuals. What is our mission? As part of a national movement founded to dismantle class inequality, we are committed to ensuring that state-educated students have access to the same networks, opportunities, skills, and influence that privately educated peers have historically enjoyed. CONNECT with your FUTURE. Through professional, social, and community-focused events, we connect Southampton students with peers, alumni, and employers, helping to level the playing field and champion social mobility on campus and beyond. Become a…

societies.name: African and Caribbean Society
societies.description: We are a student run organisation focused on providing our members with opportunities that will develop them into culturally proud and aware, well rounded individuals who feel valued during their time in higher education. Our aim is to unite students from various backgrounds through the celebration of African and Caribbean culture while encouraging them to excel in their academic and career pursuits.
societies.instagram_bio: University Of Southampton’s Official African & Caribbean Society Page! Other Socials and events in the Link Below

societies.name: AhlulBayt Islamic Society
societies.description: The Southampton AhlulBayt Islamic Society (ABSOC) is a student-led community inspired by the teachings of the Holy Qur'an and the AhlulBayt (AS), the family of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). Across the Muslim world, the AhlulBayt are respected for their knowledge, character, devotion, and commitment to justice, compassion, and service to humanity. ABSOC aims to provide a welcoming space for students to explore Islamic teachings, develop spiritually, and build lasting friendships. Throughout the year, we organise lectures, discussion circles, social events, charitable initiatives, commemorations, educational workshops, and interfaith activities. Our society…
societies.instagram_bio: A student-led community based on the teachings of the holy Quran and Ahlulbayt (as) Want to join the WhatsApp groupchat? Send us a DM! ✉️

societies.name: Airsoft
societies.description: We are a society that promotes and engages in the sport of Airsoft. Everyone from first-timers to seasoned veterans are welcome, and with trips to sites all over South England there's plenty to cater for everyone's tastes.
societies.how_to_join: And with sites catering to all kinds of gameplay you are free to choose whether you want to lead the charge through a building or stalk a sniper through the woods.Our membership brings benefits beyond our game days.

societies.name: Albanian Society
societies.description: Our society focuses on bringing students of Albanian heritage and those interested in Albanian culture together in order to become more culturally aware and proud. Our aim is for members to learn more about the rich history of the Albanian diaspora, our language, culture, and of course our beautiful valle, as well as to join us in celebrating our independence days and traditional festivals. Ju Mirëpresim!

societies.name: American Football
societies.description: The Southampton Stags American Football Club are a growing and thriving team currently competing in the BUCS South West Division 1 League. Here at the Stags we look to foster a culture of growth, encouragement, and enjoyment. We encourage players of all skill sets to join, whether you’ve been playing for years or have never picked up a ball. All we ask for is a great attitude, willingness to learn, and the drive to keep pushing forward no matter what. We look out for one another here at the Stags and joining this team is a decision you’ll never regret. Join the Stampede, Join the Stags!

societies.name: Amnesty International
societies.description: We are the Southampton University Affiliated Amnesty International Student society. Amnesty International is an organisation which works independently and impartially to promote respect for all the rights set out in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. Within the Southampton Amnesty group, we aim to raise awareness and money for a range of issues by organising events, fundraisers and campaigns.

societies.name: Anime and Manga Society
societies.description: Southampton Anime and Manga Society is a society dedicated to the mutual interest in anime, manga and other aspects of Japanese culture. https://discord.gg/RtEYFCUBpx
societies.instagram_bio: University of Southampton Anime and Manga Society ✨Society for all things anime — watch, chill, connect
societies.regular_schedule: We're a society dedicated to Anime, Manga and other aspects of Japanese culture, meeting weekly on Wednesdays and Fridays. For Wednesday sessions this year (2026-27) we are hosting game show style quiz nights, followed by an hour of different anime previews each week. Friday sessions are for socials, and we endeavour to have a mix of pub socials and non-pub socials so that everyone can enjoy themselves and feel safe here.

societies.name: Archaeology Society
societies.description: A subject group for students of, and those interested in, Archaeology at the University of Southampton. We provide social and educational opportunities, activities and trips relevant to the subject, especially to help students (and staff in the Archaeology department!) mix. We aim to broaden and support the understanding of Archaeology in the University and provide support to students where needed.
societies.instagram_bio: For Archaeology lovers at the University of Southampton (degree or otherwise)

societies.name: Archers Road FC
societies.description: Archers Road FC are an Intramural Football team founded and resided at Archers Road Halls. We offer two teams spread over 4 divisions over Wednesdays and Sundays. We are a diverse club welcoming people from ANY course and from ANY halls. Our 1s team play Division 1 on a Wednesday and Division 2 on a Sunday. Our 2s team play Division 2 on a Wednesday and Division 2 on a Sunday. In addition to this, we offer regular social events and an annual tour, you do not want to miss out. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate in contacting us directly through our Instagram @archersroadfc

memberships.name: Archers Road Football Club Playing and Social Membership 2026/27

societies.regular_schedule: We are the third most successful intramural team in the University of Southampton's IM league, most recently winning Division 2 Sunday in the 1's and Division 3A in the 2's. We have a 1st team and a 2nd team, both play in the Wednesday and Sunday IM divisions, so two games a week. The 1st team play in Division 1 Wednesday and Division 2 Sunday. The 2nd team play in Division 2 Wednesday and Division 2 Sunday. Weekly training sessions.

societies.name: Archery
societies.description: We are a friendly club open to all members of the University of Southampton, including Undergrads, Postgrads and Staff. We accommodate anyone interested in just shooting for fun as well as those looking for something more competitive
societies.regular_schedule: The course includes weekly coaching covering the basics of shooting and all equipment needed will be provided.
societies.how_to_join: For those of you who are new to archery, we run a Beginners Course starting in October which runs for 3 weeks and must be completed if you wish to be part of the club. There are a variety of time slots available, so please select one in the membership options that you can commit to for the full 3 weeks.

societies.name: Art Society
societies.description: Welcome to Art Society! We welcome students of all abilities and experience levels! We are aiming to create a welcoming and open environment where you can come and have time to create your own art, meet new people, and have access to new materials and ideas you might not have tried before! Our sessions are every Thursday in the study space outside Veg Out from 6pm to 8pm. We're a no-pressure society, and you certainly don't need art experience to join - just a passion for creativity!
societies.regular_schedule: We have art sessions running every Thursday from 6-8 pm in the space outside Veg Out.
societies.how_to_join: To gain access to our sessions, please purchase a Semester 1 or Year Membership. However, if it's your first time coming to Art Soc then your session is FREE.

societies.name: Artificial Intelligence Society
societies.description: At the University of Southampton AI Society we aim to create a common learning space for people with an interest in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. We organise talks with professionals from the AI industry and with research staff from well-known institutes, as well as hackathons and workshops.
societies.instagram_bio: Making Artificial Intelligence easy for everyone at @uni_southampton !

societies.name: Asian Cultural Society
societies.description: Welcome to the Asian Cultural Society (ASOC)! We’re a friendly and inclusive community bringing together students who share an interest in South Asian culture, heritage and everything that comes with it. Whether you’re looking to meet new people, make friends or simply have a good time, ASOC is a place where you can feel at home. From relaxed socials and games nights to cultural celebrations, club nights and exciting collaborations, there’s always something happening throughout the year. Come along, get involved and make some unforgettable memories with us!
societies.instagram_bio: ✨Official University of Southampton Asian Cultural Society ✨Follow our TikTok asocsouthampton ✨Follow our page for more events and updates 🫶

societies.name: Association of British and Chinese University Students (ABACUS)

societies.regular_schedule: Our training sessions are on Mondays 6-7pm and Thursday 7-8pm at Wide Lane.

societies.name: Athletics & Cross Country
societies.description: Southampton University Athletics and Cross-Country Club provides training and competition opportunities for all levels. Competitions include Varsity vs Portsmouth, BUCS XC, BUCS indoors and BUCS outdoors (British University and College Sport). We also have a team in the Hampshire cross country league, and regularly have team trips to open events through out the year, including FNUL events at Battersea Park, Telford 10k, LUCA opens, Watford opens and many more (we have England Athletics affiliation, so all performances can be recorded on Power of 10, if you are not already a member of a club at home)

societies.name: Badgers (Basketball)

societies.name: Badminton Club
societies.description: The University of Southampton Badminton Club (SUBAD) welcomes anyone and everyone to play. We have opportunities for casual badminton through RecBad or for those wishing to play competitively in our Development, Eagles and Performance wings too. We have complete beginners and experienced players, so all abilities are catered for! All in all, it’s a great chance to meet new people, enjoy our varied socials, and improve your badminton!
societies.regular_schedule: Our main weekend sessions (Saturday 12:00-15:00 and Sunday 12:00-14:00 in the Jubilee Sports Hall) consist of mostly doubles matches and singles at less busy sessions (ALL abilities are welcome)! societies.name: Baking Society
societies.description: Baking Society is a fun, welcoming space for anyone who loves baking (or just loves eating it 👀). We meet weekly to share homemade bakes, chat all things food, and enjoy a relaxed midweek catch-up. Each week, our committee sets a new baking theme to inspire what members bring along. Whether you go all out or keep it simple, everyone’s welcome to get involved. Our sessions also include games and social activities to keep things fun and interactive. Beyond our weekly meets, we host masterclasses and regular bakery crawls - a society favourite - where we explore some of the best bakeries together. We meet every Wednesday, 6-7pm. Make sure to check out our Instagram for the latest updates and…

societies.name: Ballet Society
societies.description: Welcome to the University of Southampton Ballet Society! We have something for everyone, providing relaxed and fun weekly ballet classes at 3 levels: Beginners/Improvers, Intermediate, Advanced as well as a Pointe class. So, whether you have been dancing for as long as you can remember or are looking to try ballet for the first time, or even if you are just looking for a great way to stay flexible and fit, we hope you come along and get involved. As well as ballet classes, we have an active social calendar with events offered throughout the year. Ballet Society members have the opportunity to perform in the university’s annual dance show, Pure Dance, which showcases the work of all the…
societies.regular_schedule: In addition to our weekly classes, we hold auditions a few weeks into Semester 1 for our Intermediate and Advanced squads, who compete at inter-university dance competitions across the country during Semester 2.
societies.how_to_join: Here at USD Ballet, we are your port of call for all things ballet, whether you are a complete beginner or have been dancing for years! 🩰 5:00-6:15pm Beginners/Improvers

societies.name: Ballroom and Latin Dance Society
societies.description: We are Southampton University's Ballroom and Latin Dance Society. We encourage and teach dance at both a social and competitive level. Weekly classes for all standards are taught by professional teachers and we also compete regularly throughout the year against other universities across the country. We perform demonstrations at local events and organise Southampton's very own Strictly Come Dancing every year! We are a very friendly and welcoming community open to all for enjoyment, fitness and involvement in the student union through our love of Ballroom and Latin dance... 'Keeeep Dancing!'
societies.instagram_bio: University of Southampton Ballroom & Latin Society🐬Join us for classes, technique and socials -with opportunities to compete!

societies.name: Bangla Society
societies.description: The University of Southampton's Bangla Society. As a dynamic community, we celebrate the diversity and traditions of Bangladesh while fostering a supportive environment for students from all backgrounds. Through cultural events and social gatherings, we aim to promote cross-cultural understanding and create lasting friendships.
societies.instagram_bio: Welcome to the University of Southampton’s Bangladesh Society! 🇧🇩

societies.name: Bar Society
societies.description: The Bar Society is a student-led legal organisation at the University of Southampton that deals with student exposure to the legal profession and guidance for students looking to pursue a career at the Bar or elsewhere. We aim to give a range of opportunities so that students can decide whether a career in law, particularly at the Bar, is something they wish to pursue. To this end, we provide events designed to improve employability by developing transferrable skills such as public speaking, networking and writing. To do this, we hold regular legal career orientated events such as mooting competitions, networking socials and skills workshops. There is something for everyone at Inns.…

With multiple competitive teams at all levels of the BUCS system, there are opportunities for anyone looking to play basketball and we are excited to meet any freshers at trials and welcome back the returners as we prepare for a successful 25/26 season. Read below for more information on trials, club structure and more!
societies.how_to_join: After the committee's fantastic job last year, membership numbers almost doubled... and with the committee returning some key figures and introducing some new faces with fresh ideas, SUBC isn't a club to miss out on this coming academic year.

societies.name: Beekeeping Society
societies.description: BeeSoc provides all the training, kit and bees needed to learn the ancient skill of beekeeping, regardless of how much experience you have.
societies.regular_schedule: Throughout the spring and summer, we will perform weekly inspections of the hives, and hopefully extract lots of honey at the end of the season!
societies.how_to_join: Sign up to our free membership and follow us on Instagram @subeesoc to be notified about our upcoming events and so you don't miss out on any events.

societies.name: Bhangra Society
societies.description: Southampton Bhangra Society is a community created to spread the art of Bhangra throughout our University. We are running weekly classes, focusing on creating a safe space for all students to dance, with the opportunity to dance competitively. We encourage students from all backgrounds!
societies.instagram_bio: The official page of Soton’s Bhangra team 👌🏽 Links to the group chat and tiktok page below! ⬇️

Membership provides access to regular Bhangra dance classes, workshops, and performance opportunities at university events and cultural events.

societies.name: Biological Sciences Society
societies.description: BioSoc is the society for all students studying a Biological Sciences degree! Our primary goal is to cultivate a cohesive, vibrant, and supportive community within the School of Biological Sciences. We strive to ensure that every student feels valued and well-adjusted to university life through our various socials, events and welfare sessions!
societies.instagram_bio: Welcome to the @uni_southampton Biological Sciences Society! 💚
societies.how_to_join: Year Membership is only £5!

societies.name: BioSoc (Netball)
societies.description: We are a friendly and inclusive Intramural Netball club with three teams at the University of Southampton. One team is in league 1 (Birds), one team is in league 2 (Bees) and one team is in league 3 (Butterflies), meaning that we cater to a wide range in abilities, helping to build the perfect team for you and your level of confidence with the sport, so all are welcome! We train twice a week and have regular socials and matches - all information and updates are posted on our Instagram - @sotonbiosocnetball, and our WhatsApp group (please contact one of our committee members if you wish to join this!) 💜

societies.instagram_bio: BLSN is a safe space for anyone interested in law, whether you study it or not! We aim to bridge the gap for BAME students, but everyone is welcome 🤗

societies.name: Black Women's Project

societies.name: Bluetits (Netball)
societies.description: Well hello; you've managed to stumble across Southampton's Medics' netball team & Medsoc's largest all female society - The Bluetits! Our training, matches, and socials are designed to fit around a busy medicine schedule allowing you to get your mind off medicine (we all need to sometimes!). We welcome girls of all abilities - whether you're a seasoned pro or haven't played since Year 9 PE! This year, we can't wait to maintain our Intramural (IM) league winners title and get playing other unis in the NAMS League. So if you're looking for weekly training, cracking socials, weekly hungover matches, and getting to know a lovely bunch of women, come and join us! Follow us on Instagram…

societies.name: Boat (Rowing)
societies.description: SUBC is one of the largest clubs of Team Southampton, supporting roughly 100 members. Our aim is to develop a community of performance-driven athletes, inspiring growth and achievement at the highest levels. We welcome both experienced and complete beginners, and everyone between. Throughout the year, our members race at small and large events including BUCS, Henley Women's Regatta and Henley Royal Regatta. We are proud to not only be a rowing club, but a family to our members with an active and inclusive social scene to meet people within the club outside of training. If you want to know more, please check out our website (subc.co.uk) or Instagram (@subcrowing).
societies.regular_schedule: We are a very active and sociable club, managing to get out on the water multiple times a week, land training together, and letting our hair down on socials weekly. Water sessions occur 3 times a week (Wednesday afternoons, Saturday and Sunday) or more if tide allows from the Watersports Centre near Wessex Lane Halls.

societies.name: Bollywood Dance Society
societies.description: The Bollywood Dance Society is dedicated to promoting and celebrating the dynamic art form of Bollywood dance within the university community. Bollywood dance is a vibrant fusion of Indian classical, folk, and contemporary styles, known for its expressive storytelling, energy, and cultural richness. Our society aims to provide an inclusive and welcoming environment for students of all backgrounds and experience levels to explore this unique dance style. Through regular workshops, rehearsals, and performances, we hope to foster creativity, confidence, and cultural appreciation among our members. In addition to dance training, we plan to host more social events, collaborate with other…

societies.name: Book Club
societies.description: A society for people to meet and discuss books that they've read together and discover new books that they wouldn't otherwise read.

Throughout the year we will provide extra support and career guidance to students studying neuroscience at Southampton. Please follow us on Instagram and join our WhatsApp group to stay updated on all our event announcements. societies.regular_schedule: We are a group of enthusiastic and friendly students who meet every Sunday night! Rehearsals are 7-9:30pm on Sunday evenings in the the Veg Out Space (B42) during term time, and have a relative relaxed atmosphere.

societies.description: Although we are called 'Southampton University Canoe Club' we are in fact a group of whitewater kayakers! A growing and nationally successful club, SUCC accommodates anyone from people who have never kayaked before (which is how most people join us), to expert paddlers. We run weekly sessions in the pool and on the river, with both weir and flat water sessions, with trips every fortnight and at least one awesome social a week, so there's something for everyone. societies.name: Canoe Polo
societies.description: Canoe Polo combines kayaking and ball skills into an exciting contact team game where tactics and positional play are as important as the speed and fitness of individual players. The game requires both teamwork as well as skill in a range of different techniques unique to the sport. Each team has five players on the pitch (and up to three substitutes) who compete to score in their opponents goal which is suspended two metres above the water. The ball can be thrown by hand or flicked with the paddle to pass between players and shoot at the goal. Paddling with the ball is not allowed, so teamwork is essential. Pitches can be set up in swimming pools or any stretch of flat water. Polo boats…

societies.name: Capoeira
societies.description: Capoeira was born out of the slave trade around 500 years ago in Brazil. It was developed by the slaves as a martial art, however, it was designed to look like tribal dances and rituals so that the slave masters would not suspect the violent aspect of the art. A crucial component of learning Capoeira has been the ability to mask your movements and intentions in an apparently non-threatening dance, combining combat and music. At Southampton, we have an enthusiastic Capoeira teacher, Mestre Joaozinho, who teaches the Angola style of Capoeira and we also have open training sessions to practice together. You're welcome to come to any of our sessions! Your first session is free. Please see our…

societies.description: We run local conservation days on Sundays, restoring ecosystems and biodiversity around Southampton and Hampshire. We work with local nature reserves and wildlife trusts on heathland restoration, invasive plant removal, coppicing, tree planting, and more. Membership is free, along with free tea, coffee and biscuits on tasks. We also hold socials. We meet on Sunday mornings around Southampton, usually around 9, and mostly use buses to travel to tasks, but we also volunteer at places within walking distance, we usually come back around 4. Remember to join the mailing list or Whatsapp group and sign up to the tasks, so that we know who's coming.

Each session is followed by a social such as board games, going to a pub or watching a film. societies.name: Human Powered Aircraft
societies.description: The Southampton University Human Powered Aircraft Society (SUHPA) designs, builds and tests its own human powered aircraft. These flying machines are powered exclusively by the pedaling of their pilot, and represent an enormous engineering challenge. The Society is currently developing its Super Lazarus and Channel Crosser aircraft designs. We compete in the Icarus Cup Competition every year and have won numerous awards.

societies.name: Human Powered Submarine
societies.description: We are a group of students at the University of Southampton that design, build, and test human powered submarines to compete internationally! We have competed in the International Submarine Races in 2015, 2017 and 2019 at Naval Surface Warfare Centre in Carderock, USA. The society consists of students from a range of degree types and stages and our members come from a variety of backgrounds including engineering, naval architecture, astronautics & aeronautics, biology, chemistry, physics and environmental science. However, just because you're not a STEM student doesn't mean you can't get involved! We welcome students of all disciplines to join us to help with engineering or SCUBA dive with…
societies.instagram_bio: Follow us as we work to build bigger and better submarines and race in international competitions!⛴

societies.name: Humanitarian Aid Society
societies.description: The Humanitarian Aid Society brings students together to support people affected by conflict, poverty, displacement and humanitarian crises around the world. Through fundraising events, awareness campaigns and community activities, we aim to make a meaningful difference while creating a welcoming space for like-minded students. Everyone is welcome-whether you are passionate about humanitarian causes, want to help others or simply want to meet new people.
societies.instagram_bio: UOS Humanitarian Aid Society Fundraise and raise awareness across countries affected by wars, natural disasters,poverty,displacement and injustice🌍🤍

A very family-like community developed over the years, even graduated students come back to some events and we are always looking to meet new members and welcome them into the society. If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact any of the committee members. We cannot wait to meet you!

Our aim is to create a genuine home away from home where students from all backgrounds can connect and feel that they belong. Throughout the year, we bring people together through cultural celebrations, socials, sport, career opportunities, charity initiatives and much more. Join us to meet new people, celebrate culture and create memories that last far beyond university. One Family. Endless Memories. ✨

The first session is always free so why not give it a go?

Each year, LOpSoc presents at least two shows: these are often operettas written by Gilbert and Sullivan, or other musical works. The former of these is performed for a second time at the International G&S Festival in Buxton every August. These British theatre classics are always comedic, extravaganzas. Anybody who wants to get involved, be in on stage or off, in either of our shows is very welcome! societies.name: Live Music Society
societies.description: LiveSoc provides a platform for musicians and music lovers to enjoy performing and watching live music in and around Southampton. Our aim is to host regular jams, gigs and open mics, provide support and equipment to budding musicians, and to meet and socialise with fellow music-lovers!
societies.instagram_bio: 📍University of Southampton’s Live Music Society 🎶Weekly jams on Saturdays in the Plant Pot 💥Gigs, socials and events ALL below!

societies.name: Malayali Society
societies.description: The University of Southampton Malayali Association (SMS) is a cultural society, which aims to introduce the student community to the unique culture and language spoken in the south Indian state of Kerala. We plan to create a home away from home for students at the University with Keralite connections and others by hosting events like games nights, clubbing nights, movie nights, small trips and finally our biggest event of the year Onam. We aim to have a big event and a small event every month. The events are designed to help evolve a friendly bond between students to develop a cultural environment through which we can help each other socially and academically. To further this, we have a…

societies.name: Malaysian Students Association Southampton
societies.description: The Malaysian Students Association (MSA) of Southampton is a non-profitable organisation which aims to secure the welfare of the Malaysian community in Southampton and promote Malaysian culture to other countries. We host a lot of social and cultural events throughout the year with the mission to encourage, foster and develop good ties among our members.
societies.instagram_bio: We are the Malaysian Students’ Association at the University of Southampton! Sign up as a member on SUSU to enjoy our Member Benefits! (Link is below)

societies.name: Mandarin Christian Fellowship
societies.description: We are a group of students mainly, but not exclusively, with Chinese background meeting regularly every Friday evening to share God’s love! We welcome students from Mainland China, Malaysia, Taiwan, Singapore, Hong Kong or UK, in whichever languages you prefer to converse (Mandarin, English or Cantonese). The objectives are to nurture the Christian faith of the members; to support them by having fellowship with one another as well as equipping and encouraging them to be rooted in God’s word.
societies.regular_schedule: We have regular meetings every Friday.
societies.how_to_join: No matter where you come from - Mainland China, Malaysia, Taiwan, Singapore, Hong Kong or the UK - we warmly welcome you to join us.

societies.name: Maths Society
societies.description: Welcome to SUMS. The hub for all things mathematics at the University of Southampton! Whether you're studying pure maths, applied maths, or any related field, SUMS offers a vibrant community for students who share a passion for numbers, problem-solving, and mathematical exploration. We host a variety of events including social meet-ups, academic talks, puzzles, and competitions, fostering a supportive environment where students can grow both academically and socially. Join us to enhance your university experience, collaborate with like-minded individuals, and dive deeper into the fascinating world of mathematics!
societies.instagram_bio: 🎓University of Southampton Maths Society 🔢 Affiliated with IMA 🧮 Events | Socials | Study Sessions 🤓 Proudly making maths less "boring"

societies.name: Mayflower FC
societies.description: Southampton's finest IM football establishment. Born from Mayflower Halls, but here for everyone to enjoy a great standard of enjoyable football. UTM!

societies.how_to_join: Our teams currently compete in Division 1 of the Wednesday league, as well as Divisions 1 and 3 in the Sunday league, with our 1s looking to push for varsity this year, for the first time.

societies.name: Medics Revue
societies.description: Medics Revue is an inclusive, close-knit group of idiots who put on a yearly comedy performance paired with song parodies and dancing, for the education and entertainment of our fellow students. All proceeds go towards raising money for the MedSoc charities. We have roles for everyone who wants to get involved: from being on stage to painting sets, doing tech or playing in the live band accompanying the show. All levels of talent (or lack thereof) are welcome to perform! We do a week of performances during November and have socials throughout the year. Follow our Instagram to stay in the loop - @sotonmedicsrevue. See you at auditions!

societies.name: MedSoc
societies.description: Welcome to the University of Southampton Medical Society! With over 1400 members, we are one of the largest societies in the Union, and aim to provide our members with a varied and exciting calendar of events and activities throughout the year.
societies.instagram_bio: Uni of Southampton's Medical Society 🩺 Welfare: @sotonmedwelfare Events: @sotonmedevents Education: @sotonmededucation Societies: @sotonmedsocieties
societies.regular_schedule: We also provide you the latest news and views through our weekly Bulletin, and have education resources to support your learning and future careers.

societies.name: Medsoc Monty
societies.description: We are a charity dance society, with a little bit of stripping, which puts on one dance event a year. The society is open to everyone and the focus is on having fun, body positivity, raising money for charity, and of course stripping.

societies.name: Melodics
societies.description: Melodics, Southampton's a cappella vocal group, is non-audition and open to anyone regardless of previous singing experience, meeting every Thursday between 6 and 8pm. The group works to develop unique arrangements of pop songs, new and old, for performance in a fun and relaxed environment, with a variety of games and activities. We run three free taster sessions at the beginning of the academic year, but if you miss this opportunity, you're welcome to come along to any of our sessions to try the society out for free. Please don't hesitate to get in contact either on Instagram or by email with any further queries
societies.how_to_join: We are an A Capella choir open to all abilities who hang out and sing once a week, with no auditions required.

societies.name: Middle Eastern & North African Society
societies.description: The University of Southampton Middle Eastern & North African Society is a cultural, non-political university society aimed at bringing together Middle Eastern & North African and non-Middle eastern students at the university and to give an insight into Middle Eastern culture, traditions, and history. It is open to people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, races, and beliefs. Whether you are from the Middle East & North Africa or not you will find something of interest to yourself from lectures and films, to cultural nights and meals!

societies.name: Midwifery Society
societies.description: MidSoc is a midwifery-specific society which represents the needs of the student midwives at Southampton University. The society aims to provide a platform for students to network, socialise, take part in study days and discuss issues that are specific to midwifery. The society enables students to have a voice and engage with the wider midwifery community as we believe that this is fundamental for student experience and personal professional development.
societies.instagram_bio: University of Southampton's Midwifery Society 🎓 💌 midsoc@soton.ac.uk 💌

societies.name: Mind Society
societies.description: MindSoc is a society that aims to raise awareness of mental health issues both around our university campus and beyond; acting as a support group for those who may be struggling. We host a variety of fundraising events throughout the year, in which the proceeds go towards supporting the local charity Solent Mind, as well as allowing us to keep doing what we do! The society also hosts weekly tea and talk sessions and biweekly sober socials, which provide the opportunity to meet others who are also passionate about mental health awareness, as well as enjoy some mindfulness and de-stress.
societies.instagram_bio: student led society at @uni_southampton supporting @solentmind through fundraising efforts and promoting awareness of mental health
societies.regular_schedule: Weekly tea and talk sessions, plus biweekly sober socials.

societies.name: Mixed Martial Arts (MMA)
societies.description: Whether you're looking to learn to fight, get fit, boost your confidence or learn self-defence, we have it all! Mixed Martial Arts is a brilliant way to hone your skills and meet new people. We specialise in Muay Thai and Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, with additional wrestling and MMA classes. We're a friendly and sociable club always who are willing to take on people of any skill level, from beginner to seasoned professional. Please don't feel intimidated if it's your first time; our lovely committee are always on hand to help out! If you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact a member of the committee through our Instagram.
societies.regular_schedule: We run a free women's-only self-defence session every week to empower women with techniques that may save their lives and help them feel confident. We put it all together in our weekly sessions where we learn important takedowns, submissions, pins and striking techniques MMA fighters use.
societies.how_to_join: We are accessible to all skill levels, from total beginners to seasoned professionals – we have a wide range of people from all backgrounds and levels of experience.

societies.name: Model United Nations
societies.description: SOTONMUN is a society dedicated to those who enjoy discussing politics and international relations, global issues, and current events. When participating in Model United Nations, you take on the role of a delegate, representing countries or individuals from around the world in a wide range of committees. You will discuss issues ranging from climate change to education to international security and more! Since our establishment in 2012, we have been one of the leading UK MUN societies, with our members having the opportunity to attend a variety of conferences in the UK and abroad, such as the London International Model United Nations Conference (LIMUN) and our very own conference: SotonMUN.…

societies.name: Monte (Football)
societies.description: The Wessex Lane Football Club © Monte FC features high quality football, being the only Southampton football team to win at Varsity. We play matches on Wednesdays and Sundays , with training on Saturdays, and we go into this season aiming to defend our league title success. We also host high quality socials every Wednesday, often with other societies too, making it a perfect way to meet new people and enrich your university experience. We also embark on an annual monte tour during the easter break, which is widely regarded as the best few days of the year by current and past members of the club. The curtain is closed on the season with a traditional Monte Boat Ball where we set sail with…
societies.regular_schedule: Both teams play twice a week (Wednesday and Sunday) with training every Saturday.

societies.name: Monte (Netball)
societies.description: Monte Netball Club are an all-inclusive netball team representing Montefiore halls of residence. We have 3 teams for different abilities and there are no trials to join. We are a friendly and fun group of girls who always welcome new players!

Also, matches against other IM teams take place every Sunday for all of our teams.
societies.how_to_join: We have no trials to join and cater for all abilities - our girls range from complete beginners to county level players so there's something for everyone! We are a fun and friendly club, with our membership fees being just £12 for the whole year for newcomers.

societies.name: Montefiores Exiles RFC
societies.description: The Montefiore Exiles represent Wessex Lane accommodation on the rugby pitch. We represent Wessex Lane accommodation but we welcome players from all halls and experience levels in rugby. Joining the Exiles will give you the chance to form lifelong friendships and get stuck into uni life, all whilst playing friendly rugby at the longest standing IM rugby club. We train twice a week on Wednesday and Sunday afternoons at riverside park, just a short walk from Wessex Lane, and play regular fixtures in these same slots. Weekly socials are the…

societies.name: Moose (Rugby)
societies.description: A strong team ethos with a dedication to the improvement of everyone in their rugby ability leads to us creating successful rugby teams with a focus on enjoyment above all else. Academic help is also provided. For next season we are looking to win the Medical Schools' Cup to earn us our 4th title. We offer student led clinical teaching to medical students to help for placement and exams! Sessions are held across the year hosted by older students, anyone is welcome!
societies.instagram_bio: The best rugby club at Southampton Uni since 1974 All courses and abilities 3x🏆 Medical Schools Championship 15’s 5x🏆 Medical Schools Championship 7’s

societies.name: Mountain Bike
societies.description: The Southampton University Mountain Bike Club is a group of active and friendly riders. We ride twice a week on Wednesdays and Sundays, meeting on the redbrick (Just outside Stags!). Ride times may vary with weather and daylight hours. We do all styles of Mountain Biking including Cross Country, Enduro, Downhill and Dirt Jumping. We go on regular trips to venues such as QECP, Puddletown forest, Watchmoor and FoD, with at least 2 big weekend trips a year to huge parks within the UK like Bike Park Wales. Most commonly we can be found at Southampton Bike Park and the volunteer built trails at Lordswood. Don't be afraid to get in contact! We look forward to meeting you at Bunfight, our rides…

Our experienced committee helps run the club, and if you have any questions please feel free to contact one of us below.
societies.regular_schedule: We have four BUCS teams that compete weekly on Wednesdays against other universities across the country. Squad 1 (1st and 2nd teams) – training on Monday evenings (8:00–10:00 pm) Squad 2 (3rd and 4th teams) – training on Thursday evenings (8:00–10:00 pm) Every Wednesday night, we host themed socials that are fun, inclusive, and a great way to celebrate game day together.

societies.name: Neurodiversity & Disability Society
societies.description: We're a society aimed at students who identify themselves as neurodivergent or disabled, those who are undiagnosed or self-diagnosed, and any members of the community that wishes to learn more about neurodiversity and disability issues.
societies.regular_schedule: We are currently hosting weekly socials every Thursday from 6–8pm.

societies.name: NeuroSoc
societies.description: NeuroSoc is a society where members have an interest in anything Neurology related! We are in all years of medical school, so everyone is welcome. In addition, we will be having the Neurology Undergraduate conference which is an exciting whole day in person event. So, if you have an interest follow our social media pages- Southampton NeuroSoc- where all our events are posted, and we look forward to meeting you!
societies.instagram_bio: Follow for all things Neuro! 🧠 Guest Speakers | Teaching series | Revision Sessions | Research Opportunities | SNNRC Annual Conference

NurSoc takes students' experience at university very seriously and we aim to regularly engage with students in a number of ways through face-to-face meet ups, socials, responding to queries via Facebook, Instagram or Email (nursoc@soton.ac.uk). societies.name: Occupational Therapy Society
societies.description: Welcome to the University of Southampton Occupational Therapy Society! All Occupational Therapy Students are welcome to join. Follow our Instagram @otsocsoton and X @SotonOTSoc to keep updated. We are a friendly, supportive society. Please contact us at any time, and we will try our very best to help.

If you have any questions just send us an email or DM us on instagram @SUWLC and we'll reply as soon as possible.

societies.name: Once a Month

Ideally, the project would go on for one hour each month and would be a fun, relaxing space in which volunteers can make friends with like-minded people. At these sessions, volunteers will pack bags containing sanitary and hygiene products. Due to the pandemic and government lockdowns, we have not been able to meet regularly; however, we have been able to make large amounts of donations. These bags that we pack are taken to charities and organizations by the project leaders with the assistance of a few…

societies.name: Optics and Photonics Society

This has resulted in a greater interaction between students in the ORC and the wider optics and photonics…

societies.name: Padel Society
societies.description: We are a padel society open to students of all abilities, whether you are completely new to the sport or already play regularly. Padel is a great sport for bringing people together, and we hope to create a community where everyone feels comfortable getting involved. As a society, we would help promote student wellbeing, teamwork, and social interaction through regular sessions and events. Whether…

societies.name: Paediatric Society

societies.instagram_bio: University of Southampton’s Paediatric Society 🌈🧸🩻 Providing lots of educational content and useful information for anyone with interest in Paeds!!

societies.how_to_join: Join us for our range of events from social to sports to Eid dinner to balls! Make sure you sign up for the membership to get discounted tickets!

societies.name: Palestine Solidarity Society

societies.how_to_join: We believe in the power of art and community to provide a meaningful space for discussion and invite everybody — students and staff — to join us.

societies.name: PGR Netball

Rehearsals are Monday evenings from 19:30 - 21:30 at Turner Sims on Highfield Campus, and are led by our professional conductor Cole Bendall. The mix of the two choirs gives a unique blend of youthful voices with those of more experienced singers. It also offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to perform major musical pieces with a large-scale ensemble, and with a full, professional orchestra and professional soloists.

societies.name: Philosophy Society

societies.name: Snowsports Club
societies.description: Southampton University Ski and Snowboard Club, or as we call it, SUSSC, is one of the largest societies of the Athletics Union. Our society wants to encourage you, no matter what level you have, to give snowsports a try or perhaps just to join us in our socials! We organise two big trips a year: one in Christmas and one in Easter where we hit the mountains for one of the most amazing weeks of your life - these are open to anyone regardless of their level of involvement in the society! Join our weekly training at the local dry slopes where we prepare ourselves to smash the inter-university events of the year and become part of one of our teams: Freestyle or Racing. Head over to our website:…
societies.how_to_join: Whether you're a skier or snowboarder, racer or freestyler, beginner, alpine god, or just here for the après, SUSSC welcomes you with open arms! We welcome all and can’t wait for you to join us on a table at après this Christmas!

societies.name: Socialist Students Society
societies.description: At the Socialist Students Society, we are a big tent of socialists at the university helping to organise for funding higher education, tenants’ rights for students, and promoting a world beyond capitalism. Together with other groups in Southampton and beyond, we are committed to empowering young people to make a difference in politics. We come from all backgrounds, united in solidarity. Politics isn’t just something which happens to us. Instead, we should make politics happen!
societies.instagram_bio: We are Southampton Socialist Students. Meeting, debating and organising together! You can find us at SUSU and on WhatsApp.
societies.regular_schedule: Weekly Meetings: We meet once a week, on various topics and events, both current and historical.
societies.how_to_join: If you agree, join us in the fight for a future we can look forward to not fear. It’s a bit scary the first time you do it, but as long as you’re friendly you can have some very interesting discussions with lots of people.

societies.name: Sociology, Social Policy and Criminology Society
societies.description: Welcome to the University of Southampton SSPC Society! Our society focuses on bringing together students with an interest in Sociology, Social Policy, and Criminology! But you don’t have to be on one of these degrees to join us. If you have a passion for criminal justice and understanding the social world, then this society is definitely for you. We are all about building an inclusive community where everyone can feel welcome, meet new people and share their passions. We work hard to offer events that everyone will enjoy! Throughout each year, we run a wide range of events, from guest speaker evenings and documentary nights, to relaxed socials, pub trips and criminology-themed nights out.…

societies.name: Somali Society
societies.description: We're a society committed to ensuring Somali students have the best experience during their time at Southampton. We want to make sure you feel welcome, push yourself to be the best you are and give back to your community at the same time. Join us now!
societies.instagram_bio: Official page of UoSouthampton SomSoc. Follow us on TikTok: sotonsomsoc
societies.how_to_join: Join us for exciting events, cultural workshops, and regular football matches—there’s always something happening, and everyone is welcome.

societies.name: Soton Medical Technology Society
societies.description: The Southampton MedTech Society is a newly formed community driven by medical and technology students. Our core aim is to create a collaborative space where these two disciplines can join, helping educate both sides and share knowledge. Our members have diverse interests spanning from cutting-edge neurotechnology to chronic disease management. We plan to run a variety of activities, including hands-on workshops to develop practical skills, talks from industry professionals and academics, and longer-term projects that will provide valuable experience in the MedTech sector. We're also going to host our own hackathon and conference, as well as attend external ones together. Our society caters…
societies.instagram_bio: Bringing students together to shape the future of MedTech.

societies.name: SotonMedEntrepreneurs
societies.description: Soton MedEntrepreneurs is the go-to society for medical students keen to master the business of medicine—from private practice setup and med-tech ventures to AI in healthcare and investment strategies. While our focus is on equipping future doctors with the financial know-how and entrepreneurial mindset to innovate in medicine, we welcome anyone from healthcare or beyond—business, engineering, computer science and more. Join us for hands-on workshops, idea-development sessions, pitch nights and candid guest talks, and turn your business ideas into real-world impact.

societies.name: South Asian Medics Southampton
societies.description: We started this society to celebrate South Asian culture and diversity! We want SAMS to be a home away from home, and to provide a space for people to connect and share experiences!
societies.instagram_bio: All are welcome! email: samssoton@outlook.com
societies.how_to_join: Come along, get involved and help us make South Asian Medics 2026–27 a year centred around community, culture, friendship and fun.

societies.name: Southampton International Medics Society
societies.description: To provide a safe and fun space for new and current international medics, where they feel comfortable socialising, asking each other for help and discussing their own cultures while learning about new ones. We have found it is very difficult for international medics to adjust to life away from home, we aim to make this adjustment easier with welfare, social and academic events.

societies.name: Southampton Marrow
societies.description: Marrow is the student-led branch of Anthony Nolan, a charity that recruits people to the stem cell register in order to provide lifesaving stem cell transplants for people with blood cancer and other blood disorders.
societies.instagram_bio: Students saving lives through stem cells A student branch of @anthonynolancharity 💚 DM us any questions you have :)

societies.name: Southampton Pub Society
societies.description: PubSoc is a society with weekly pub crawl socials run by our social secs, ranging from a variety of themes from classic pub golf to taskmaster, mission impossible, traitors, and more! (check out our insta..) PubSoc is a great place to meet new people from all years and courses without the pressure of a specific sport or hobby, and even if you don’t want to drink we do a few more casual socials such as pub quizzes and charity sports matches. We have lots of fun here and a lovely committee to help you feel comfortable as we know how daunting it can feel! We hope at PubSoc you will be able to build some long lasting friendships, and make lots of fun uni memories, as the rest of us have. We…
societies.instagram_bio: because lectures are better with a pint (afterwards.. probs) x SUSU Affiliated since 2026 🎉
societies.regular_schedule: Weekly pub-crawl socials; check Instagram for each week’s details.

societies.name: Southampton Robotics Outreach
societies.description: SRO is a group of students who are enthusiastic about getting young people involved in Robotics, Computing, Electronics and STEM.
societies.instagram_bio: Inspiring young people to get into computing, electronics and robotics
societies.regular_schedule: We hold weekly sessions on Thursdays - location may vary as our resources move around, so contact us on Discord, Instagram, or email for details!

societies.name: Southampton Swing Dancers
societies.description: We are a new society for lindy hop at the University of Southampton. Lindy hop is a fun and stylish partner dance with great swing music. Join us and learn cool moves, meet lovely people and enjoy the dance floor
societies.regular_schedule: WEEKLY LESSONS Join two amazing teachers every Thursday in The Cube.
societies.how_to_join: We have Beginner lessons from 18:30-19:45 and Intermediate lessons from 20:15-21:45 with social dancing between!

societies.name: Spaceflight Society
societies.description: Spaceflight University Spaceflight Society (SUSF) is an engineering, outreach and education society, open to anyone who wants to get involved. We design and manufacture chemical and electrical rocket engines, Mars rovers, small satellites and any other spaceflight project you can propose yourself! We collaborate within the spaceflight community to provide opportunities beyond university, as well as inspire the next generation of scientists and engineers. Most of all, we enjoy spaceflight together. We celebrate our own little launches and the famous ones; we have our own socials and collaborate with other societies; we build space stuff and have fun doing it.
societies.instagram_bio: Official account for University of Southampton Spaceflight Society

societies.name: Spanish, Latin American and Portuguese Society
societies.description: SLAPS functions to celebrate and promote the learning of the Hispanic Lusophone languages and their respective cultures; be sure to check out our FACEBOOK and INSTAGRAM pages to stay up to date. Also read on below to find out more....
societies.instagram_bio: Spanish, Latin American and Portuguese Society at the @uni_southampton 🇪🇸 🇵🇹 🇧🇷 🇦🇷 🇺🇾 🇨🇴 🇨🇱 🇵🇾 🇧🇴 & many more

societies.name: Sports and Exercise Medicine Society
societies.description: The Sports and Exercise Medicine Society is a student-led group dedicated to exploring the role of physical activity in health, performance, and rehabilitation. We host expert-led talks, interactive workshops, and focused revision sessions to support medical students interested in injury management, exercise physiology, and lifestyle medicine. Whether you're pursuing a career in sports medicine or simply passionate about staying active, our society offers a welcoming space to learn, connect, and get inspired.

societies.name: Squash
societies.description: University of Southampton Squash Club is for anyone interested in the fast-paced racket sport of squash. Our strong social side means the courts are also a great place to meet new people.
societies.regular_schedule: Weekly Club Nights open to all abilities Monday: 6-10pm, Club night Tuesday: 6-7pm Ladies night, 7-10pm Ladies Hampshire match Wednesday: 2-6pm BUCS matches, 7pm Social Thursday: 6-7pm Beginner training, 7-10pm Hampshire 2s match Friday: 7-10pm Hampshire 1s match Sunday: 6-8pm Team training
societies.how_to_join: Weekly Club Nights open to all abilities Beginner sessions with coaching to help you get started

societies.name: Sri Lanka Society
societies.description: Founded in 2003, The Sri Lankan Society was formed to act as a platform for Sri Lankan students to socialize and help one another in their University life away from home. The Society is focused on organizing events to educate and help the foreign community learn about the rich, vibrant and diverse culture that Sri Lanka has to offer
societies.instagram_bio: | ආයුබෝවන් | வணக்கம் | As-salamu alaykum | 🙏🇱🇰 . Welcome to the Instagram Page of the University of Southampton Sri Lankan Society.
societies.how_to_join: Come join us and be part of our community to explore and celebrate the warmth and vibrancy of Sri Lankan culture—open to all!

societies.name: Stage Technicians' Society
societies.description: StageSoc is the Stage Technicians' Society - covering all aspects of backstage craft and technical theatre: lighting, sound, set building and stage management for all of Performing Arts.
societies.instagram_bio: We are the Stage Technician's Society, providing backstage support for Performing Arts at the University of Southampton.
societies.how_to_join: Whether you're interested in tech or you love theatre but prefer to stay backstage, anyone is welcome to join - no experience necessary!

societies.name: Steampunk Society (Kraken Soc)
societies.description: Southampton University Steampunk Society aims to provide a focal point for Steampunks, Cyberpunks and Dieselpunks at the University of Southampton. Membership of the society is free, and we are open to anyone with an interest in Steampunk, Victoriana, science fiction and retro-futurism, from the simply curious to the more learned. We're a social society, and run weekly events, most regularly film nights usually followed by a social. In addition we run other events including music gigs, day trips, games nights, workshops and attend steampunk gatherings both locally and around the country. As a society, we also make an effort to socialise with the local groups in the form of collaboration…
societies.how_to_join: Follow us on Instagram under the name uos_steampunk_society and Join us on Discord https://discord.gg/uAnvRM23d4 if you would like to join or if you have any questions!

societies.name: STEM Netball
societies.description: We are a friendly intramural (IM) netball team at UoS, inclusive to all abilities and degrees🏐 We train every Wednesday and Saturday and have fun regular socials. We don’t have any trials to join our team :)
societies.regular_schedule: We hold 2 trainings every week:
societies.how_to_join: Membership to our team is free - you will just need a sports pass or a full UoS sport membership to use the Southampton sports facilities.

societies.name: Street Dance Society
societies.description: The Street Dance Society at the University of Southampton runs weekly classes across varying levels and styles. From beginners to advanced, we have something for everyone. So if you are an experienced dancer or a complete beginner we have something for everyone. We bring together people who love dancing and create a friendly environment for everyone to enjoy themselves and improve their street dance skills. We offer a range of different styles of Street Dance for you to try, from locking to house, waacking to hip hop, or if you just want to groove on your favourite track, join us in the Multi Purpose Studio (MPS). We also offer Afro Classes on a weekly basis so you can try a whole new…
societies.regular_schedule: Classes are held every Wednesday afternoon:
societies.how_to_join: Classes are in the Multi Purpose Studio in the SUSU building- come along to any of them and see if Street Dance is for you! Beginners - 1.00 - 2.00 pm

societies.name: Student Scout And Guide Organisation
societies.description: Do you want to learn new skills working with young people, attempt a variety of activities, and make lifelong friends? If so, the Southampton Student Scout and Guide Organisation (Southampton SSAGO) is for you! We are a University of Southampton society, interested in volunteering in the local Scouting and Guiding community, and just having fun. However, even if you’re not involved, we welcome anyone who is interested in Scouting and Guiding associated activities – from 'art' to bake-offs, campfires to film nights, pub crawls to hiking, and much more! If you want to work towards your Duke of Edinburgh’s Gold Award, the world's leading youth achievement award, recognised in over 144…

societies.name: Sub-Aqua (Scuba Diving)
societies.description: Scuba dive in the UK and abroad during your degree! SUSAC is the University of Southampton’s branch of BSAC (British Sub-Aqua Club), and we welcome everyone - from complete beginners to qualified divers trained with any organisation. Learn to dive, improve your current qualification, or simply enjoy regular diving with us. Our fully qualified instructors run training at highly competitive prices, from beginner courses through to advanced diver grades and specialist Skill Development Courses. Alongside diving, we also run a variety of socials throughout the year, giving you the chance to meet like-minded people who share a passion for adventure, skill-building, and the marine world. To see…
societies.how_to_join: You do not currently need Sport and Wellbeing membership to join or take part in any of our activities. All you need is SUSAC membership, and if you want to dive, you’ll also need BSAC membership for insurance purposes.

societies.name: Sudanese Society
societies.description: Welcome to the Sudanese Society in Southampton (SudSocSoton)! Our society is dedicated to fostering a vibrant community among Sudanese students and anyone interested in Sudanese culture at the University of Southampton. We aim to provide a supportive and inclusive space for members to connect, celebrate, and share our rich cultural heritage. Through a variety of events, including cultural celebrations, educational/awareness stalls, and social gatherings, we strive to promote understanding and appreciation of Sudanese traditions, languages, and customs. Whether you're Sudanese or simply intrigued by Sudanese culture, we invite you to join us in exploring the diverse tapestry of our heritage…
societies.instagram_bio: University of Southampton Sudanese Society 🇸🇩🇸🇸 Bringing Sudanese culture to Soton 🌍 Events | Socials | Community

societies.name: SUENS Hockey
societies.description: Southampton University Engineers and Nurses Hockey (SUENs) is a friendly mixed IM team open to all abilities and degrees. No prior experience is required, and equipment can be provided. Whether you are looking to play competitively or develop your skills, the team will welcome and support your goals with regular training, matches and of course socials (of the drinking and non-drinking variety). For more information, contact us via Facebook, Instagram or Email as listed on our page.
societies.regular_schedule: To get involved, feel free to come to our training sessions every Friday 8-10pm (from 03/10/25) at Southampton Universities Wide Lane sports ground.
societies.how_to_join: IM hockey is played across a range of skill levels, from those with no experience to members that also play AU club hockey. No experience is required, and equipment can be provided.For any other queries please contact us on Instagram (@suenshockey) or Facebook ("SUENs - Southampton University Engineers and Nurses Hockey").

societies.name: SUHC Mixed Hockey
societies.description: SUHC Mixed Hockey provides students with the opportunity to play mixed hockey in a friendly, inclusive and competitive environment. We take part in IM fixtures, external mixed hockey competitions, friendlies and tournaments, and welcome players, of all abilities, who are keen to get involved in mixed hockey at university.
societies.how_to_join: We welcome players of varying experience levels, whether you already play regular hockey or are looking to get involved in mixed hockey for the first time.

societies.name: Surf
societies.description: SUSURF is one of the largest surf clubs in the country with over 160 members! We run regular trips to Bournemouth, weekend trips to Devon/Cornwall/South Wales every 3-4 weeks, and at least one international trip a year to some of the greatest surf locations in the world like France, Portugal and Morocco. Unlike many other societies, we run weekly relaxed socials as well as normal socials every 2-3 weeks. SUSURF is a very warm and friendly society, and we're always happy to welcome new faces to the SUSURF family!! Be sure to join our Whatsapp group to keep up to date with everything we are doing. And see some of our adventures on our Instagram: @southamptonunisurfclub We ask that you are…

societies.name: SURGE
societies.description: Southampton University's award winning student radio station
societies.instagram_bio: Award-winning Student Radio at @uni_southampton Since 1976 📻 What’s on?: @surgemembers Join and Listen👇

societies.name: Surgical Society
societies.description: Welcome to the Surgical Society! We’re dedicated to shaping the next generation of surgeons through hosting interactive events, teaching and mentorship. Whether you are beginning your medical journey or preparing for finals, you will find a place here to learn, lead, and grow.
societies.instagram_bio: Welcome to the University of Southampton Surgical Society! 📧: sotonsurgisoc@outlook.com

societies.name: SUSingers
societies.description: SUSingers is a fun non-auditioned choir, welcoming singers of all abilities and experience! We sing a wide variety of music genres, including musical theatre, pop, jazz and traditional choral arrangements. We hold two concerts a year – a Christmas concert at the end of semester one and a summer concert in semester two. Rehearsals are held every Sunday from 6.45-9pm in room 46/3001. We have two free taster sessions at the beginning of the year but always welcome new members throughout the year! Feel free to come along to one of our rehearsals or get in touch with any questions. We also host lots of socials throughout the year, such as barbecues, karaoke nights, games nights, bowling and…

societies.name: SUStrings (String Orchestra)
societies.description: SUStrings is a friendly and inclusive string orchestra which was founded to provide string musicians the opportunity to play and explore the extensive and varied repertoire for string orchestra. There are no auditions and anyone who plays the violin, viola, cello or double bass is welcome. Occasionally, we may do some difficult pieces that are Grade 5 standard or above, but everyone is more than welcome to come and have a go at the pieces. We rehearse weekly, perform at least one concert per term and one tour per academic year. Rehearsals: Every Monday 7-9pm in the Maths Common Room (B56). To keep up to date with what's going on go to our Linktree [https://linktr.ee/sustrings] to find our…
societies.regular_schedule: We rehearse weekly, perform at least one concert per term and go on one tour per academic year. Rehearsals: Every Monday 7-9pm in Building 28/1019 & 1021 on Highfield Campus starting 21st September 2026.

societies.name: Swallows (Football)
societies.description: The Swallows are the ladies medics football team representing Southampton University. We are a friendly, sociable group and welcome all abilities from beginners to pros! The Swallows have a range of players from 1st year through to 5th year so it is also an excellent way to gain insight and advice. We have training sessions every Tuesday evening at Wide Lane and we also take part in a weekly local 5 a side league and regional NAMS league. In addition to this we have regular socials, Brighton Varsities, annual NAMS tournament, as well as our yearly European tour which is always a great time! If you fancy getting involved come find us at bunfight or you can contact us on instagram…
societies.regular_schedule: We train every Tuesday evening and participate in a regional NAMS league - providing the opportunity to play other medical schools from across the country. We also participate in 5-aside matches every week, and are planning to participate in the new women's IM as of 2026/27. Our social secs also organise weekly Saturday socials, which are an excellent opportunity to get to know other swallows, unwind from the world of medicine, and even see some of the best that Portswood has to offer (aka Jesters).
societies.how_to_join: We welcome all abilities, from complete beginners to Lionel Messi in his prime.

societies.name: Swimming
societies.description: Winning's the Aim — Swimming's the Game: Catering for competitive and recreational swimmers alike
societies.regular_schedule: We’re excited to announce that full training resumes Monday 21st September! Training starts Monday 21st September for both Freshers and Returners (CHECK SCHEDULE below) PRE-SEASON TRAINING - Sunday 13th September to Sunday 20th September, RETURNERS ONLY (schedule is the same as below) Every Wednesday night members of both squads come together for a social, all of which having a theme. ​In addition to our weekly socials, we have bigger one-off socials throughout the year including: Christmas meal, Boat Ball, Athletic Union Ball and Tour.
societies.how_to_join: Memberships and Sports Pass details can be found on our website - purchase a membership through the membership section on this site (make sure you're logged in) And it's where you'll get invited to our socials (if you have a membership)

societies.name: Symphonic Wind Orchestra
societies.description: SUSWO is the only auditioned wind orchestra at the University of Southampton and is open to all woodwind, brass, and percussion players. Originally founded by woodwind and brass players at the University, we are a friendly ensemble that welcomes talented musicians from across the University. We play a varied and challenging repertoire to a high standard, giving our members the opportunity to perform regularly as part of a talented ensemble. Auditions take place every September/October, and the orchestra has approximately forty members. We aim to perform three concerts a year, as well as going on a joint European tour with the other auditioned ensembles (SUSO, Sinfonietta). If you are…
societies.instagram_bio: Facebook @suswo.official

societies.name: Symphony Orchestra
societies.description: SUSO is widely recognised as one of the leading student orchestras in the UK. We take on some of the most famous pieces in the professional repertoire, while also being one of the most fun and sociable societies on campus! Look out for pre-term and audition sign up information on our socials!
societies.regular_schedule: We will be holding a Give-it-a-go session on Wednesday 23 September, 6:30-9:30pm in Turner Sims! We rehearse every Wednesday during term time from 6:30pm - 9:30pm in Turner Sims Concert Hall on campus, and often perform here as well as other local professional venues.
societies.how_to_join: To come along make sure to sign-up here so we know who will be there: https://forms.gle/3WLMEjc5VGGiabEH9 For more information on what we do, or how to join us, contact our President Finlay Caldow at suso@soton.ac.uk, or check out our socials @susorchestra

societies.name: Table Tennis
societies.description: Come down to try out table tennis - it's a great way to meet new people! We welcome everyone, whether it be your first time picking up a racket or if you're a seasoned professional, we'll be sure to have someone for you to play against. You're welcome to bring friends along too, to finally settle who's better at table tennis. If you would like to improve your game join our Development team. We will provide all equipment and cater to all levels so make sure not to miss out! For more info, updates, pictures and videos, follow us on Instagram.

societies.how_to_join: Come along, play some table tennis and meet new people — no matter your ability. Recreational Membership gives you access to three sessions a week during the academic year:

societies.name: Taekwondo
societies.description: SUTKD is the university’s Taekwondo club, open to all levels from beginners to black belts in WT and ITF. The club trains in sparring, patterns, and self-defence, combining powerful punches and flashy kicks. Studio 3, First Floor, Jubilee Sports Centre. Find us on Instagram (@sutkd_).
societies.regular_schedule: Wednesday - 6-8pm Thursday - 4-6pm (ITF focused session) Sunday - 1-3pm FREE TASTER SESSIONS: Saturday 19th September 15:00 - 17:00 and Sunday 20th September 13:00-15:00 in Studio 3 in Jubilee Sports Centre!!!
societies.how_to_join: Whether you’re a complete beginner or an experienced competitor, you’ll find opportunities to learn, train, and compete as part of a supportive team. If you want to try taekwondo, you are able to have 2 FREE TRIAL SESSIONS AT ANY POINT THROUGH THE YEAR before needing to buy a membership.

societies.name: Tamil Society
societies.description: The Tamil Society brings together those who are captivated with the ideas and traditions of Tamil culture. It aims to organise social, cultural and sports events in order to raise money for charities and other worthy causes, as well as providing opportunities for individuals to participate in inter-university competitions. We hope that in the future, Tamil Society will become a gravitation point for people of all kinds to learn about the unique nature of Tamil culture, and South-Asian culture in general.

societies.name: Tap Dance
societies.description: Welcome to the wonderful world of tap dancing! Tap dance society offers three classes every Wednesday, for beginner, intermediate and advanced levels. Our lovely qualified tap teacher combines technical steps with funky moves and jazz hands to create a perfect stress relief from uni work! Our aim is to give dancers a chance to learn something brand new, improve their technique and ability, but mostly to have fun and get involved in a friendly and sociable society. In second semester, all three classes have the opportunity to perform in the annual USD Pure Dance show for which each class prepares a routine! We also have an intermediate and advanced tap squad who represent us at…
societies.regular_schedule: Tap dance society offers three classes every Wednesday, for beginner, intermediate and advanced levels with our wonderful qualified teacher, Lucy. We also have many other opportunities alongside the weekly Wednesday classes:
societies.how_to_join: Tap dance society offers three classes every Wednesday, for beginner, intermediate and advanced levels with our wonderful qualified teacher, Lucy. Beginners: 5-6

societies.name: Tea Society
societies.description: Lectures sapping your mental energy away? We've got the perfect solution - a nice, hot cup of tea. Tea Society is a relaxed society catering to disabled, neurodivergent, and LGBTQIA+ individuals, though all are welcome. We provide a safe space to step away from your studies and relax once a week with like-minded individuals. Feel free to show up as often as you like - you can come every week or once a year. We're here when you need us. Alongside our regular meetings, we do regular socials like powerpoint nights, board game socials, quizzes, and holiday parties. Wednesdays from 5-7pm in B42/3019!

societies.name: Team Southampton Motorsport
societies.description: Team Southampton Motorsport is the dedicated motorsport club for the University of Southampton. We are primarily a karting club and hold events suitable for drivers of all skill and experience levels. For F1 fans we run a variety of social events for members to meet fellow enthusiasts, watch and discuss races. Keep an eye out for us at Bunfight or contact us directly to find out more.
societies.how_to_join: Membership We offer three levels of membership to the society, dependent on the level of investment/involvement desired:

societies.name: Teddy Bear Hospital
societies.description: Teddy Bear Hospital is a friendly, fun and diverse society whose aim is to educate children and work to alleviate their fears of going to the doctors. We give students the opportunity to visit a range of schools and settings across Southampton, where we teach children through play about visiting the doctors, looking after their health and how to stay safe.
societies.instagram_bio: the @uni_southampton branch providing health education to primary school children🩺🩷 MedSoc Dean Awards 2025 - Community Impact Award Winners

societies.name: Telugu Society
societies.description: The Telugu Society at the University of Southampton brings together students who speak or are interested in Telugu language and culture. We celebrate regional festivals like Ugadi and Sankranti, host events around Telugu music, movies, dance, and food, and create a close-knit, supportive community. We also help freshers settle in, build friendships, and connect members with academic and professional support networks.
societies.instagram_bio: స్వాగతం సుస్వాగతం 🙏🏽 Southampton Telugu Society Join our WhatsApp group for event updates 🎉, cultural vibes 🪔 & fun activities 🎨.

societies.name: Tennis
societies.description: Southampton University Tennis Club welcomes everyone who is interested in playing tennis and looking for a great social atmosphere! We are one of the largest sports teams on campus and always have room to keep on growing.
