societies.name: The Edge
societies.description: The Edge is Southampton's award-winning entertainment magazine, run solely by students at the university. Here at The Edge we cover all aspects of entertainment writing, from reviews and interviews, to critical feature pieces and the latest news within the industry. We’ve covered big releases, such as an early album stream of Olivia Rodrigo’s GUTS, a private screening for Parasite, and an interview with beabadoobee, right through to local university news like the Share the Sound Festival put on by our Music department, and shows put on by our theatre societies such as Be More Chill and The Trial of Dorian Gray. Whether you study humanities or computer science, we want to hear from you. To…
societies.how_to_join: To write for The Edge, the only criteria is that you’re a University of Southampton student with a love for entertainment – whether that be film, theatre, literature, or even podcasts No experience is required, and we all started a little messy when we began writing for The Edge, so please don’t let fears about your writing ability put you off Passion is what we’re interested in, and that will shine through no matter your experience Outside of writing, The Edge is one of the most welcoming societies you can join Membership is free, you don’t even have to write to join us, but we can often be found debating who will win the latest series of RuPaul’s Drag Race in The Bridge The Edge is an…

societies.name: The Mindful Medical Society
societies.description: The Mindful Medical Society opens the exploration of health and human flourishing to all staff and students. We have two main aims: (1) Broaden Perspectives on Health: We explore diverse ideas on health and human flourishing to nuance understandings of what it means to care and be cared for. Events in the 25/26 calendar included: Collaborating in Illness (Dean of Southampton Medical School, Professor Diana Eccles); Are plants more then placebos? (Dr Wilcox); Cold Water Therapy (Associate Professor Heather Massey); Restructuring Mental Healthcare (Dr Armstrong); How we Suffer (Consultant Psychiatrist Carlos Hoyos); The Science of Breathing (Dr Mohan). (2) Enhance Student Welfare: We…

societies.name: Tigers (Tennis)
societies.description: Hello! We are Tigers Tennis - Southampton's Medics Tennis Club. If you're looking for a hit around, to play a match or just to learn how to hold a racket, this is where you want to be! We run two sessions Wednesday 7-9pm (more drill and match focused) and Saturday 9-11am (more fun and games) at Wide Lane Sports Ground and welcome everyone from complete beginners to experienced players. Non-Medics are also welcome to join! We also have chilled (and sometimes slightly competitive) socials every few weeks run by our wonderful committee, for drinkers and non-drinkers alike. We hope to see as many of you as possible on the courts!!! Lots of Tigers love 🐯The Committee of 2025-6 xxx

societies.name: Touch Rugby
societies.description: Touch Rugby is a mixed non-contact sport inspired by rugby league and is one of the fastest-growing international sports to date. SUTRC are an Athletic Union and BUCS team representing the University of Southampton regionally & nationally.

societies.name: Turkish Society
societies.description: The University of Southampton has students from various nations that come to United Kingdom and start their journey of higher education. This can be hard for those leaving their family and loved ones behind. In order to, smooth out this transition and give these new students somewhere they belong. One of these nations is Türkiye, with a significant number of Turkish students in the student body. This society aims to satisfy that need and help out Turkish Students to communicate and teach Turkish culture to those interested.

societies.name: TurkSoc FC
societies.description: Welcome to TurkSoc FC, hoş geldin! Born in 2026 from our shared love of Turkish football culture, TurkSoc FC brings together University of Southampton students from all nationalities, backgrounds and ability levels to compete in the Wednesday 11-a-side Intramural League. As a newly established society, we aim to build a welcoming community both on and off the pitch, with a variety of football and social events taking place throughout the year. Whether you are an experienced player, a passionate supporter or simply looking to meet new people, everyone is welcome. Get ready to experience the crazy Turkish fans and their unforgettable atmosphere!

societies.name: Union Films
societies.description: Union Films is your student-run cinema, right at the heart of Highfield Campus. Located in the Union, we're completely run by volunteers; from the front of house staff who sell tickets and refreshments, to the projectionists who show the films on our 35mm and digital projectors. You can help out as much or as little as you like, and when you do, you get to see films for free!

societies.description: The University of Southampton Ophthalmology Society is a student-led society dedicated to promoting interest in ophthalmology, eye health and vision science. We aim to provide accessible opportunities for all students to learn about ophthalmology as a medical and surgical specialty through careers talks, clinical skills workshops, academic teaching, research and audit opportunities, mentorship, and networking with clinicians and trainees. We support students considering ophthalmology, improve exposure to a specialty that can be underrepresented in the medical curriculum, and encourage wider engagement with eye health, visual science and healthcare innovation. societies.name: Vegan and Vegetarian Society
societies.description: Whether you're a vegetarian, pescetarian, vegan, or an open-minded omnivore, join the Southampton Vegan and Vegetarian society to have fun and enjoy the benefits. Our goal is to provide a competitive but friendly team experience, with a focus on improvement, teamwork, and enjoying the game. Whether you're looking to get back into basketball or just want to try something new, there’s a spot for you on the Warriors roster. We play with energy, pride, and hunger and we live by our motto: Built Different.…

societies.description: We aim to increase diversity within Medicine and improve access to opportunities for current and future medical students. We host a variety of workshops to support students when they apply to study medicine, including BMAT/UCAT and mock interview workshops. We run a successful E-Mentoring Scheme and are hoping to launch a podcast and newsletter this year!

societies.name: Wild Swimming society
societies.description: The Southampton University Wild Swimming society (SUWS) is an inclusive society where we can all share a love for adventure, spending time in beautiful outdoor locations, and immersing ourselves in nature's waters. The society organizes regular trips to our local wild swimming locations and exciting adventures to more picturesque destinations further afield. Besides the profound positive impact on our physical and mental health that comes with wild swimming, SUWS offers a thrilling and sociable way to immerse in nature.
societies.instagram_bio: click here to see more about us 🌀🦦

societies.name: Wilderness and Expedition Medicine
societies.description: Southampton Wilderness and Expedition Medicine Society = SWEMS! We run talks, scenario sessions and teaching events themed around Wilderness (jungle, deep sea, desert, polar) medicine, but are most well-known for our group walks and camping trips which in the past year took us to areas of natural beauty such as Brecon, Snowdonia, the South Downs and Dorset. We have a huge mix of experience when it comes to outdoorsy stuff/wilderness medicine, so our camping trips and teaching sessions are very relaxed and cater to all levels and backgrounds. We are a small but welcoming society who love the outdoors for its beauty, the chats and friendships which happen within. If you love walking in the…
societies.instagram_bio: Southampton Wilderness/Expedition Medicine Society, better known as SWEMS! We offer walks, hikes, and strolls. With some medicine. Of course. 🏔 🥾 🩺🚑

societies.name: Wildlife Society
societies.description: 𓍊𓋼𓍊𓋼𓍊 Hi! We're Wildlife Society! 𓍊𓋼𓍊𓋼𓍊 We run nature-themed events and trips in the Southampton area and all over the UK! Everyone is welcome, regardless of their degree or previous experience, all you need is a passion for wildlife. Our regular events include weekly documentary screenings, mushroom walks, pub and sober socials, as well as big trips to museums, aquariums, and wildlife parks. We primarily use Instagram to advertise, as well as a WhatsApp chat we use that's linked on our Instagram! Join a relaxed, inclusive community of nature nerds! Make friends, take part in competitions and explore the world around you!

Alongside windsurfing, we offer opportunities to try Wing Surf and Wing Foil.

societies.name: Women in Business Society
societies.description: We are a society with a goal to improve the representation of women in corporate and commercial sectors including law, banking, politics, and engineering to name a few. We aim to challenge the low figures of women within these sectors by: i) Providing work experience opportunities; ii) Hosting regular inspirational talks; iii) Giving young women the opportunity to mentor and be mentored by other women; iv) Encouraging young women to volunteer at partner organisations (Southampton Women's Centre) to enhance their employability; and v) Creating a long-lasting alumni network.

events.title: Socialist Students Society: Students, war and militarisation
events.description: It's a contradictory time to think about war. Around Armistice Day, as we commemorate the end of World War I, it gives us time to remember the horrors of war, and question what we celebrate every 11th of November. This year, war has only intensified with America's attacks on Iran, the continuation of the Russo-Ukrainian War, and the Palestinian genocide continuing into its fourth year. What Socialist Students aims to discuss is that if we can pinpoint the root causes of war, should that concern us with the rapid military rearmament Europe is experiencing, and the defence spending being prioritised in last month's budget? The discussion will be a roundtable; feel free to voice your thoughts with respect to others' perspectives.

We'll be sharing practical CV writing advice, highlighting common mistakes, exploring how to make your application stand out and discussing how to make the most of the opportunities available to you. Members of the 93% Committee will be offering personalised CV reviews, giving you the opportunity to receive individual feedback and suggestions to help strengthen your application. So make sure to bring a copy of your CV along! As part of our commitment to widening participation and promoting social mobility, we want to help break down barriers to employment and make career opportunities more accessible to everyone. Join us afterwards at Stags for a chance to unwind, meet new people and make some…

events.title: Socialist Students Society: Students, racism and oppression
events.description: Our final workshop meeting themed around the International Youth Strike occurring across Europe, is dedicated to a long-standing issue which jeapordises students' safety, and serves as a scapegoat to distract from national crises. Racism and oppression is being normalised by political opportunists seeking to divide and conquer. In whatever form we've seen, from Reform UK's extremist councillors exposed by ITV's documentary last month, or the lingering legacy of the 2024 riots, to the rise of Islamophobia, Socialist Students takes a resolute stance against racism. And it remains ever important to discuss its origins, its consequences, and anti-racist solutions which get at the heart of capitalism. The discussion will be a roundtable; feel free to voice your thoughts with respect to others' perspectives.

events.description: A play by Anton Chekhov In the Russian countryside, 1904, Lubov Ranevsky returns to her estate with her family after five years in Paris. At the heart of the estate lies their famous, beautiful cherry orchard. However, beneath the elegant surface, there is a problem: the family is bankrupt. A newly wealthy merchant offers a solution, but there is a catch: the heart of their ancestry must be destroyed.

events.title: Up All Night - An Independent Show
events.description: As the bells of Saint Mark's Church chime midnight, graduation is finally over- adulthood is about to begin. In the darkness, four friends ponder their futures: their hopes, their dreams. But thirty years on, what paths did they actually take? What lives did they actually lead?These are the questions explored within "Up All Night" as we follow the unforgettable lives of James and Jennifer, two university sweethearts, navigating the world of adulthood alongside their close friends Chrissy and Stu. Over one night separated across thirty years, their lives dramatically intertwine as their relationships are forged and tested, ultimately asking whether the futures we dream of are worth the cost.

events.description: As the bells of Saint Mark's Church chime midnight, graduation is finally over- adulthood is about to begin. In the darkness, four friends ponder their futures: their hopes, their dreams. But thirty years on, what paths did they actually take? Over one night separated across thirty years, their lives dramatically intertwine as their relationships are forged and tested, ultimately asking whether the futures we dream of are worth the cost.

events.title: Monday run club
events.description: Join us for our weekly Monday 5km run! We meet outside Stags on campus at 6:30pm and have 2 groups, each paced by a committee member - one at 5:30/km pace and one at 6:30/km pace.

events.title: Weekly Vigil for Palestine
events.description: Our weekly vigils are run alongside Palestine Solidarity Network to provide a welcoming space to discuss current events, engage in open and truthful discourse around Palestine, and empower those who feel helpless in the face of global injustice. Stand together for justice and peace.

events.title: Impact groups
events.description: Join us at your nearest halls site for a freshers social with party food, games, soft drinks and chat! Get to know people in your halls! Find us in the common rooms of Wessex Lane, Glen Eyre, Archers Road and Orion Point halls. Impact groups are a chance to look into and be spurred on by the Bible so we can go out to be a light to others on campus. Everyone is welcome, it's a great chance to make friends, play games and enjoy community!

events.title: IM Rugby Taster Session
events.description: 🏉 Welcome to Engineer's Rugby! 🏉 No matter your experience or your degree, everyone is welcome here at the University of Southampton! Whether you're a seasoned player or have never touched a rugby ball in your life, we offer a completely free, inclusive, and enjoyable rugby experience. What We Offer Flexible, Fun & Free: Open to all abilities and all degree subjects. Regular Training: Join us every Wednesday and Sunday from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM on the Common. Action-Packed Schedule: Take part in exciting matches and tournaments throughout the academic year. 📍 Location & Info: Training takes place on the Common. For exact pitch locations and updates, check out our Instagram: @suesrugby. Come down, meet the team, and get involved!

events.title: Free Women's MMA session
events.description: Free Women’s Mixed Martial Arts Session 🥊 Looking to mix up your fitness routine, learn a new sport, and build serious confidence? Come down to the SUSU activities room every Thursday at 1pm to 3pm for our Women’s Mixed Martial Arts session, hosted by the MMA Society! We’ll be covering the fundamentals of MMA: combining striking, grappling, and movement in a fun, high-energy, and totally supportive environment. Absolutely zero martial arts experience is required. Just bring some comfortable gym clothes and a bottle of water. Join the WhatsApp community link below to let us know if you are coming and if you have any questions! https://chat.whatsapp.com/Hh6R4OMrcHdBw7I6Q45hWl
